lessons.trigger_condition: The verified UNKNOWN→WATCH path can persist declarative WATCH rows, but runtime-created WATCH rows had no bounded retirement lifecycle. If official and independent-market evidence disappears for many candidates, stale rows can permanently consume the 64-row registry capacity and reduce future autonomous TCG discovery.
lessons.prevention_rule: Retire only WATCH rows marked evidence.auto_watch_seeded=true after at least 180 days without fresh official or marketplace evidence. Never auto-delete manually curated WATCH rows. Preserve recent auto-WATCH rows, reclaim stale auto-WATCH capacity before unknown-candidate admission, and keep all promotion, grading, profit, market-direction, source-code and CI safety gates unchanged.
validation_required: auto_watch_retire_after_days is exactly 180 and cannot be lower than review_window_days
only WATCH rows with evidence.auto_watch_seeded=true are automatically retired
fresh local official or independent market evidence prevents retirement
fresh registry official or marketplace-depth evidence prevents retirement
manually curated WATCH rows are never automatically retired
retired capacity is reclaimed before new unknown candidates are admitted
Elestrals remains a verified WATCH seed and is promotable only through review_registry evidence gates
Pokémon ONE PIECE NARUTO remain the only grading-enabled game IDs
mandatory collection job count remains exactly 8
screen neural remains exactly 17 inputs 12 hidden units and 18 allowlisted outputs
profit guarantee investment-return prediction and market-direction prediction remain false
no runtime source auto-rewrite arbitrary command direct-main write or verification bypass is introduced
physical tablet runtime remains unverified until matching device-side receipt exists
lessons.safety_boundary: This lesson manages stale declarative discovery state only. It does not guarantee profit, infer future price direction, fabricate inventory, auto-enable non-core grading, force Elestrals promotion, alter the 17→12→18 neural architecture, weaken CI, or claim physical Lenovo deployment.
